北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大体感寒冷，请务必多穿衣物，注意防风保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is very cold and windy. Please dress warmly and protect yourself from the wind!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感舒适，记得享受这美好的天气！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and pleasant. Enjoy the lovely weather!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，气温适中。注意补水，保持好心情哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy with mild temperatures. Remember to hydrate and stay cheerful!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，温暖如春。出门记得防晒，心情也美美哒！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm. Remember sunscreen and enjoy your day!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳天气晴好，温暖舒适。适合户外活动，保持活力哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant. Perfect for outdoor activities, stay active!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，体感微凉。记得添衣，别着凉哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny with a slight chill. Remember to add layers and don't catch a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感较冷且风大，多穿点，注意保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, chilly, and windy. Dress warmly and stay bundled up!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，气温舒适。记得多喝水，保持身体水润！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Remember to hydrate!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云风大体感凉，出门记得添衣，小心着凉哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, windy, and cool. Remember to add layers when you go out!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗但干燥，体感偏凉。多喝水，注意保湿！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but very dry and cool. Drink plenty of water and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，气温适中。出门记得戴口罩，保护好呼吸道！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, with mild temperatures. Wear a mask outdoors to protect your respiratory system!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨冰天雪地，体感极寒！请务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold! Please bundle up completely and protect yourself from frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -26℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感很凉。多穿厚衣服，别让寒气入侵！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and very cold. Wear warm clothes to keep the chill away!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温宜人。享受舒适天气，保持好心情！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with pleasant temperatures. Enjoy the comfortable weather and stay cheerful!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感偏凉。出门添件外套，小心别着凉！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and cool. Bring a jacket when you go out to avoid catching a cold!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风大体感寒冷，请务必多穿衣，注意防风保暖哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is very cold and windy. Please dress warmly and protect yourself from the wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风大体感极寒，请务必多穿衣物，小心防寒保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is very cold and windy. Please dress warmly and protect yourself from the wind!
